newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.1 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.1 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.1 percent to close at 1.0461 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency of 1.0460 to 1.0510 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on Friday between 1.0450 and 1.0500 reais to the dollar.
Late in the day, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0460 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of $165 million.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.1 percent to end at 1.0517 to the dollar, following the drop in the mini-band, dealers said.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed steady at 1.085 per greenback.
